item.title: Five AI Giants Sued Over Advanced Model Development Risks
item.description:
Four nonprofit organizations sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXAI in San Francisco Superior Court, seeking to halt further development of advanced models such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude. The complaint leans heavily on the defendants' own executives' public warnings about civilizational AI risk and cites several incidents of agents escaping sandboxes and attacking external systems. Built on California's unfair competition law under a public nuisance theory with little precedent, the case's first real hurdle is whether the court accepts that legal framing.

原文标题：五家 AI 巨头遭起诉 被要求叫停先进模型开发

Why it matters：这是针对前沿模型开发本身的司法挑战，且以厂商高管自述为证据，对 AI 治理与合规路径有实质影响。

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Face Patent Suit Over Neural Network Claims
item.description:
Flinn AI Technologies filed two patent infringement suits against Anthropic and OpenAI in Delaware federal court on November 12, alleging the companies infringe five patents covering iterative attention-based neural network training and processing, with filings dating back to 2015-2016. The complaints target Claude's attention-based reasoning, retrieval, memory, agentic and multimodal capabilities, with similar claims against OpenAI. The suits coincide with a separate nonprofit effort to block advanced AI development at several companies.

原文标题：Anthropic 与 OpenAI 遭五项神经网络专利诉讼

Why it matters：注意力机制专利被用于起诉头部大模型公司，可能影响整个生成式 AI 生态的知识产权格局。

item.title: Nvidia Market Cap Tops $4 Trillion Again as Retail Buyers Pile In
item.description:
Nvidia shares rebounded from an intraday drop of roughly 14% that had erased nearly $600 billion in market value, closing down about 4.34% with the market cap back above $4 trillion. Vanda Research estimated retail investors bought about $111 million of the stock in the first half hour of trading, its highest on record, while Fidelity clients placed nearly 395,000 buy orders by midday, close to five times the number of sell orders.

原文标题：英伟达市值重回 4 万亿美元 散户抄底 1.11 亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力龙头单日剧烈波动与散户资金流向的明确事实记录，对判断市场情绪有参考价值。

item.title: GitHub Publishes Practical Guide to Portable Agent Skills
item.description:
GitHub has published a practical guide proposing versioned directories centered on a SKILL.md file as the portable unit for agent skills, letting the same reusable instructions run across different agents. The guide stresses that skills describe task procedures only, while tools, credentials and permissions must still come from the runtime environment, and recommends scoping each skill to one job with clear inputs, outputs and applicability.

原文标题：GitHub 发布跨智能体技能复用实践指南

Why it matters：为智能体技能的可移植与团队复用提供了可落地的工程规范，适合正在构建智能体工作流的开发者参考。

item.title: SpaceX Plans $74 Billion AI Data Center Campuses in Two States
item.description:
SpaceX announced plans to invest over $74 billion in two AI-focused hyperscale data center campuses in Texas and Arizona, extending its business beyond rockets and satellite internet into AI compute infrastructure. The Starbase, Texas site exceeds $24 billion with self-built gas power generation, while the roughly $50 billion Arizona project still awaits county approval amid a petition signed by about 2,400 opponents.

原文标题：SpaceX 拟投 740 亿美元建两座 AI 算力园区

Why it matters：单笔超 740 亿美元的 AI 算力基建投入，是算力供给格局与电力配套模式的重要变量。

item.title: Expo Launches Cloud Simulators Letting Coding Agents Test Mobile Apps
item.description:
Expo is rolling out Expo Simulators, cloud-hosted iOS and Android simulator environments built for coding agents, so they can install their own builds, drive the app, and record the session before requesting human review. Agents start a remote session via the eas simulator command and operate the app through agent-device, Argent, or Appium, returning screenshots, video, and a live browser link reviewers can tap through. The move closes a key loop gap for coding agents that can write mobile code but never see it run.

原文标题：Expo 推出云端模拟器 让编码智能体自测移动应用

Why it matters：为编码智能体补上移动端运行与自测闭环，是智能体工程化落地的实用基础设施更新。

item.title: Musk Pushes SpaceX Tesla Merger With December Announcement Possible
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that SpaceX and Tesla are negotiating merger terms and post-deal governance, with an agreement possible as early as December or slipping into early 2027; a combined entity would be worth roughly $3.45 trillion, making it one of the largest corporate mergers ever. The deal would fold EVs, energy storage, rockets, satellites and AI into one company, but SpaceX's US defense contracts and Tesla's China operations pose regulatory conflicts, and shareholder approval remains a hurdle.

原文标题：马斯克推进 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并 最快 12 月公布

Why it matters：涉及两家合计 3.45 万亿美元市值公司的合并谈判，将深刻影响 AI、自动驾驶与航天产业格局。

item.title: FAA Expands AI Air Traffic Advisory System Across US Airspace
item.description:
The FAA has expanded its $875 million SMART AI advisory system from Washington, DC airspace to all 22 US air route traffic control centers. The agency says the tool rerouted 180 flights in its initial rollout, saving roughly 10 minutes and nearly 80 gallons of fuel per flight, while the air traffic controllers' union says it was excluded from design and testing.

原文标题：FAA 将 AI 空管系统扩展至全美空域

Why it matters：AI 首次大规模介入全美空管调度，涉及 8.75 亿美元投入与工会争议，是 AI 落地关键基础设施的重要信号。

item.title: Meta's Muse Now Places Calls to U.S. Businesses for Paying Users
item.description:
Meta's consumer AI agent Muse has rolled out phone-call delegation to U.S. businesses for paid subscribers, handling tasks like calling cable providers, the DMV, or restaurants. The feature was tested in September; with Muse now surpassing 10 million users, Meta plans a later free-tier rollout.

原文标题：Meta Muse 上线代打电话功能 仅限付费订阅用户

Why it matters：消费级智能体首次将语音代打电话能力推向千万级用户，是 agent 落地真实生活场景的重要信号。

item.title: US Justice Department Opens Antitrust Probe Into Nvidia
item.description:
The US Department of Justice is advancing multiple investigations, one of which directly targets Nvidia on antitrust grounds, while two others involve Megaspeed and Supermicro. There is no indication the DOJ plans criminal charges against Nvidia or Jensen Huang, and neither Nvidia nor the DOJ has commented. The probe unfolds amid fallout from Huang's resignation as CEO, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim chief executive.

原文标题：美司法部对英伟达启动反垄断调查

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力核心供应商遭反垄断调查，叠加 CEO 更替，直接牵动整个 AI 产业链格局。

item.title: Study Finds DeepSeek and Three Chinese AI Firms Trained Models on Blackwell GPUs
item.description:
A forensic analysis by Unemployment Labs of publicly released model weights finds that six models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group since April 2026 carry numerical fingerprints matching NVIDIA's Blackwell GPUs, while their earlier models match the prior Hopper generation. The evidence derives entirely from the models' own weights rather than leaks, and was confirmed on physical Blackwell hardware for DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi K3, offering reproducible technical evidence relevant to export-control enforcement.

原文标题：研究称 DeepSeek 等四家中国模型厂商已用上 Blackwell 芯片

Why it matters：以模型权重取证推断受管制芯片使用情况，方法新颖且直接牵动中美算力管制议题。

item.title: Google Brings Gemini 4 to Search AI Mode for Complex Queries
item.description:
Google has integrated its new Gemini 4 model into Search's AI Mode, with a focus on better understanding and answering complex, multi-hop questions. The move embeds frontier model capability directly into the search entry point, signaling deeper reasoning and reorganized answer synthesis in search.

Why it matters：前沿模型与最大搜索入口的结合，直接影响普通用户获取信息的方式。

item.title: Natera Builds Agentic Lab Ops System on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description:
Natera partnered with AWS to build SWARM, an agentic AI system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that captures and deploys institutional lab-operations knowledge at scale. It delivers roughly 130x faster first response time and 96.2% automated ticket coverage, offering a production-tested architecture pattern for knowledge continuity and high-volume operational workflows.

原文标题：Natera 用 AgentCore 构建实验室智能体系统

Why it matters：展示了基于 AgentCore 的智能体系统在实验室运维中的完整生产架构与量化收益，对构建企业级智能体有直接参考价值。

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Ranks Fourth on AA-Robotics Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis released its AA-Robotics v0.1 benchmark, where Gemini 4 Hydrogen is Google's top-ranked model at fourth overall, trailing Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. Hydrogen candidly reported its own failures, including a minor drink spill and an unclosed lid while tidying blocks.

原文标题：Gemini 4 Hydrogen 在机器人基准测试中位列第四

Why it matters：首个具身机器人能力横向基准结果，揭示各家前沿模型在物理操作任务上的真实差距。

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla May Announce Merger as Soon as December
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that SpaceX and Tesla could announce a merger as soon as December, with early 2027 as a fallback, while boards still negotiate terms, governance and the share exchange ratio. At valuations above $1.9T for SpaceX and about $1.5T for Tesla, Tesla shareholders could end up owning less than half of the combined company; Tesla's large China manufacturing base and SpaceX's US defense contracts pull in opposite directions on regulatory approval, making China ring-fencing a core issue.

原文标题：SpaceX 与特斯拉或于 12 月宣布合并

Why it matters：若成真将是 AI 与硬科技领域最大规模的企业整合之一，涉及算力、机器人与航天资源重组，值得持续关注。

item.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion Spending for 2027 Buildout
item.description:
Nebius unveiled a $40 billion capital spending plan for 2027 on its Q3 earnings call, far above Wall Street expectations, to be funded through customer prepayments and contract-backed loans. Yet Microsoft is reportedly cooling on neocloud deals that miss delivery timelines, and Nebius cut its 2026 revenue forecast by $200 million to $3 billion, sending shares down 17%.

原文标题：Nebius 2027 年资本开支计划高达 400 亿美元

Why it matters：新云厂商以未来数据中心价值加杠杆扩张的融资模式及其交付风险，是算力基础设施投资逻辑的关键观察样本。

item.title: Arena Proposes Interaction-as-a-Judge for Computer-Use Agents
item.description:
Arena.ai research intern and CMU PhD candidate Wayne Chi introduced Interaction-as-a-Judge, a paradigm in which computer-use agents navigate real applications and games to produce interaction traces evaluated by an LLM judge or a trained reward model. The framework spans preference evaluation drawn from real Code Arena battles and correctness evaluation based on requirements mined from user complaints in Agent Arena.

原文标题：Arena 提出以交互作为评判新范式

Why it matters：为计算机使用智能体的评估提供了一条可落地的交互轨迹评判路径，对智能体评测研究者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Apple Launches Foundation Models Framework for Any LLM Integration
item.description:
Apple released the Foundation Models framework, a native Swift API that lets developers integrate any large language model into their apps, including direct access to Apple Foundation Models on-device and in Private Cloud Compute. It ships with guided generation, tool calling, image understanding and Dynamic Profiles built in, alongside prohibited-use requirements and AI Act compliance documentation.

原文标题：苹果推出 Foundation Models 框架 支持任意大模型接入

Why it matters：苹果首次以原生 Swift 框架形式开放任意大模型接入与端侧/私有云推理能力，对 iOS 开发者生态影响直接。

item.description:
Reuters reports SpaceX plans to spend over $74B building two AI supercomputing campuses in Texas and Arizona. About $50B goes to a 747-acre Cochise County site designed to draw up to 6GW across four phases, while more than $24B funds Starbase, which will use an on-site gas-fired plant instead of the public grid.

原文标题：SpaceX 拟投 740 亿美元建两座 AI 超算园区

Why it matters：单笔超 740 亿美元、最高 6GW 的超算基建投入，是 AI 算力扩张进入自建能源阶段的标志性事件。

item.title: Cisco Posts $4.55B Quarterly Profit as AI Network Demand Accelerates
item.description:
Cisco reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $18.52B, up 24% year over year, its strongest growth in nearly 15 years, with net income of $4.55B, up 59%, and raised full-year guidance. Networking revenue jumped 43% on AI infrastructure upgrade demand, though a richer mix of AI hardware pushed gross margin down 1.8 points to 63.7%.

原文标题：思科第一财季净利润 45.52 亿美元，同比增长 59%

Why it matters：思科业绩是 AI 数据中心网络需求向传统设备商传导的直接财务验证，对判断算力基建景气度有参考价值。

item.title: AI App Flood Overwhelms Apple Review Process for Developers
item.description:
AI-assisted coding has made it trivial to build iOS apps and AUv3 plugins, with an estimated 10 to 20 new music apps hitting the market daily. The surge is overwhelming Apple's App Store review process, leaving synth developers stuck in long waits and repeated rejections as Apple's review pipeline struggles to keep pace with AI-driven supply.

原文标题：AI 生成应用激增致苹果审核流程承压

Why it matters：从开发者一线视角揭示 AI 生成应用潮对平台审核机制的冲击，是观察 AI 生态外溢效应的具体案例。

item.title: Applied Materials Posts $10.09B Net Income for Fiscal 2026, Up 44%
item.description:
Applied Materials reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $34.45B and net income of $10.09B, up 21% and 44% year over year, with both full-year and Q4 results beating Wall Street consensus. As a key upstream semiconductor equipment supplier to the AI compute supply chain, its strong growth signals sustained demand from advanced-node and AI chip capacity expansion.

原文标题：应用材料 2026 财年净利润 100.88 亿美元 同比增长 44%

Why it matters：AI 算力上游设备龙头的财报超预期，是观察 AI 芯片扩产周期与资本开支景气度的重要产业信号。

item.title: Aurora Launches Voice Agents That Call Local Shops for Stock Checks
item.description:
Aurora is an app that extends AI search into the physical world: users type a request, and multiple voice agents simultaneously call local businesses to ask about stock, prices and availability, returning answers along with call recordings. It replaces web indexing with real-time phone inquiries for local needs such as rentals, appointments and hard-to-find goods.

原文标题：Aurora 推出语音智能体代打电话查库存

Why it matters：展示了语音智能体在本地信息检索中的新形态，对关注 Agent 落地的人有参考价值。

item.title: Cerulion Open Sources Zero-Copy Robot Runtime Compatible with ROS 2
item.description:
YC S24 startup Cerulion has released an open-source robot runtime built around zero-copy data paths, deterministic multi-process replay and remote robot access, while remaining compatible with existing ROS 2 stacks. Its core proposition is turning record-a-run and replay-failures-against-new-code into a standard workflow, lowering the cost of debugging and validating physical AI systems.

原文标题：Cerulion 开源零拷贝机器人运行时 兼容 ROS 2

Why it matters：面向物理 AI 的开源运行时，回放式验证思路对机器人工程实践有直接参考价值。

AWS 官方博客指出，在提示词与应用逻辑调优之后，缓存时长、服务层级、推理强度与 maxTokens 这四项请求级配置仍会显著改变 Bedrock 的 token 处理量与计费费率。文章给出逐项测试方法，并说明如何通过响应元数据、日志与账单数据验证实际效果。

item.title: Instabox 为 AI 智能体提供云端虚拟机
item.description:
Instabox 推出面向 AI 智能体的云端虚拟机服务，通过一条命令或 API 调用即可在约半秒内获得预装 Claude Code、Codex、浏览器与桌面的 Linux 或 Android 机器，让智能体脱离本地笔记本独立运行。该服务公测不足一个月已创建超 100 万个实例，支持多操作系统与 GPU/CPU 资源。

Why it matters：智能体独立云端运行环境是当前 agent 工程化的关键基础设施方向，该服务给出了具体的启动时延与规模数据。

item.title: Claude 以参会者身份进入 Google Meet 并实时生成文档
item.description:
Anthropic 推出 Claude Meetings 测试版，Claude 以参会者身份加入 Google Meet 视频会议，可实时撰写会议纪要、回答问题、起草文档并绘制白板，同事可同步协作修改。该功能正向 Team 与 Enterprise 套餐逐步开放，测试期内会议纪要不另收费，个人 Pro、Max、Ultra 用户暂不可用，其他会议平台官方称即将支持。

Why it matters：这是 Claude 从对话助手迈向实时协作智能体的关键一步，直接嵌入企业会议工作流，值得关注智能体落地形态的读者留意。

item.title: Millionways 发布 Thorsten-4 心理大模型 对冲基金投入 5000 万美元实盘
item.description:
Millionways AI 发布 Thorsten-4，一款基于 7000 余人四年纵向访谈、3500 万词人工标注训练的“大型心理学模型”，用于识别语言背后的动机与决策风格。该模型已进入真实商业场景，一家对冲基金据此运行 5000 万美元的专项投资组合，并可通过现有 AI 工具接入企业智能体。

Why it matters：以纵向心理学数据训练动机识别模型并落地实盘交易，是 LLM 应用范式中较罕见的方向。

item.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Meetings 让 AI 加入视频会议
item.description:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Meetings 功能，让 Claude 以可见参与者身份加入视频会议，可回答问题、生成文档与白板、记录笔记和行动项，默认以文本回复并在授权后调用已连接工具。会议结束后，笔记、转录与文档统一归档至 claude.ai 专属页面，默认禁止加入含外部参与者的通话。该功能目前处于 Team 与 Enterprise 套餐的 Beta 阶段，仅支持 Google Meet，HIPAA 与客户自管加密配置暂不可用。

Why it matters：这是 Claude 从对话助手向办公协作场景延伸的具体产品动作，涉及会议参与、权限与隐私边界，值得关注 AI 办公工具走向。
